# Cardtly

> Cardtly is a digital business card platform built in South Africa. Professionals and whole teams create a branded digital business card and share it instantly by NFC tap, QR code, or link - no app needed by the person receiving it. Free for 60 days, then R97 a card per month in South African rand. Live at https://cardtly.com.

## What Cardtly is

A digital business card is an online profile that replaces a paper business card. It holds your name, role, company, contact details, links, and photo on a single page with its own URL. Cardtly cards are shared three ways: an NFC tap (hold the card to a phone), a QR code scan, or a plain link over WhatsApp, email, or SMS. The recipient can save the details straight to their phone contacts. Because the card is a live web page, the owner updates it once and everyone who has the link sees the latest version - nothing is reprinted.

## Key facts

- Company: Cardtly, based in South Africa, available worldwide.
- Price: R97 per card per month in South African rand (ZAR), billed via Paystack. There is no separate free tier - every card has the full feature set.
- Free trial: 60 days, no credit card required to start.
- Teams: 2 to 20 cards self-serve at R97 per card a month. Above 20, contact Cardtly for an enterprise arrangement.
- NFC card: an optional physical tap-to-share card, R150 once-off plus R100 shipping in South Africa. Your own artwork, printed edge to edge, is included in that price. Delivered in 5 to 7 business days, South Africa only.
- Android app on Google Play (com.cardtly.app). iOS not yet released.

## Main features

- NFC tap-to-share, QR code, and link sharing from one card.
- Your own short link (cardtly.com/card/yourname). Change it later and the old link keeps redirecting, so anything already printed still works.
- 12 card templates, fully customisable: accent colours (any hex), fonts, logo, light/dark mode, a custom background colour, and per-element text colours and sizes.
- Photo galleries, custom links, WhatsApp, social profiles, certifications, and an AI-written bio.
- Cardtly Network: a searchable directory of everyone on Cardtly, inside the dashboard. Search by company, person or job title, filter by any of 45 industries, open a company to see its people, and open any card. Included with Pro. Signed-in only, never public. Listings show name, position, company and photo, never a phone number or email address, and anyone can switch their listing off.
- Analytics per card: views, taps, link clicks and saved contacts.
- Lead capture with a built-in contacts CRM - visitors share their details and every lead lands in the owner's dashboard and inbox.
- Book-a-meeting button: visitors request a time from the card; the owner is emailed and the requester is saved to contacts.
- Custom questionnaire: up to five of the owner's own questions, with answers saved against each lead.
- Reciprocal contact exchange: after saving the owner's details, the visitor is prompted to share theirs back.
- Paper business card scanner: photograph someone else's paper card and AI extracts the details to save.
- WhatsApp follow-up: every captured lead has a one-tap WhatsApp button.
- One-click Excel export of all contacts, colour-branded, with sources and questionnaire answers.
- Weekly performance digest: a Monday email summarising the past seven days of views and new leads.
- Add your card to Google Wallet; the pass updates when the card changes.
- Email signature generator and branded virtual backgrounds for Zoom and Teams.

## For companies and teams

Cardtly is built for a company rolling cards out to a whole team, not just individuals.

- Departments, each with a head. Split the company into Sales, Support, or by branch. Each department head invites their own people, sets their look, and sees their own numbers.
- Choosable field locks. A company admin decides which of these stay fixed on every card: company logo, company name, office number, website, address, social profiles, link buttons, gallery photos, and card design. A department head can lock more for their own team but cannot unlock anything the company has set.
- Whatever is not locked stays with the person: their name, photo, job title, bio and mobile number.
- One brand, or one per department. Set the company look once and apply it to every card; a department can carry its own colours on top.
- Reporting per person: views, taps, clicks and saved contacts for each team member, and every lead they capture in one shared list.
- Network control. A team appears in the directory as one company under one logo. The admin switches individual cards in or out of the Network; the staff member keeps their own switch, and either side can remove a card while neither can force one back in.
- Per-seat billing. Add cards as you hire; an unclaimed card waits with an invite against it.

## Common questions

- What is a digital business card? An online profile that replaces a paper card, shared by NFC tap, QR code, or link, with details the recipient can save to their phone.
- How much does Cardtly cost? R97 per card a month, free for the first 60 days with no credit card. A physical NFC card is R150 once-off plus R100 shipping in South Africa, custom artwork included.
- Is there a free plan? There is a 60-day free trial rather than a permanent free tier. Every card has the full feature set.
- Do I need an NFC card? No. The QR code and the link work without anything physical.
- Can a company control what staff put on their cards? Yes. The company admin chooses which fields are locked - logo, company name, website, address, socials, links, gallery, design - and department heads can tighten that further for their own team.
- How many people can be on a team? 2 to 20 cards self-serve. For more than 20, contact Cardtly.
- Can I scan paper business cards? Yes: photograph a paper card and AI reads it into a saved contact.
